name: Wall of Slaughter: War Gate
summary: The massive Muramite gate complex leading into the Proving Grounds, fortified with elite defenders and saturated with Discord energy.
description: The War Gate is the Muramite Legion’s most heavily fortified position within the Wall of Slaughter. Towering walls, reinforced gatehouses, and elite Muramite defenders guard the entrance to the Proving Grounds. Discord corruption permeates the area, warping the gate’s architecture and creating unstable planar anomalies. Siege engines, watchtowers, and defensive pylons line the battlements. This zone represents the final barrier between the warfront and the Muramite stronghold beyond, where only the strongest forces can hope to advance.
